title: Appliance Rebates in Markham 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Markham appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient replacements, with Alectra Utilities as distributor.
lead: Markham is 82% owner-occupied, so most households who qualify will be claiming for appliances they bought themselves. The rebates run from $25 to $200.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Markham
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: Planning one replacement at a time

With 110,870 households and few renters, Markham's rebate story is mostly owners replacing one appliance when it fails. Because the page states no per-household limit and each claim has its own 60-day window, a family can claim as each appliance is bought, rather than waiting to batch purchases.

Alectra Utilities is the distributor. Markham postal codes begin with L, which the Energy Affordability Program lists. The appliance rebate itself is run through Home Renovation Savings and only asks that you are a residential customer on the Ontario grid.
Most Efficient, not just ENERGY STAR

The rebate is for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models, which the page describes as going beyond standard ENERGY STAR requirements. A fridge with the ordinary ENERGY STAR mark may not qualify. Each appliance has its own product list linked from the program page, so find the model number there before you pay, whether you buy in Markham or online.

The page states no limit per household and no end date. That does not mean unlimited funding, and the program can change. If you plan to replace a washer and a dryer, or a fridge and a freezer, get them on the program's lists first and keep every receipt, since each claim is separate and has its own 60-day window.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Markham households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.

About 19% of Markham's 110,870 households live in homes built before 1981. Age of the house tells you little about the age of the fridge, and a working appliance rarely pays back a swap through a $25 to $200 rebate alone. The rebate suits a replacement you already need to make.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Alectra offer an appliance rebate?
No. Used and refurbished appliances do not qualify.
Is the rebate paid by cheque?
The page does not say how it is paid beyond uploading the receipt.
